channel.title: Palm Coast Observer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Palm Coast Observer (observerlocalnews.com)

item.title: Florida Senate passes bill preparing for penny’s parting
item.description: A bill that would allow retailers to round to the nearest nickel following the federal government’s decision last year to cease production of the 1-cent coin passed unanimously through the Senate.

item.title: Flagler Beach commissioner's concerns with City Manager Martin fizzle without action
item.description: 'What are we doing? Is this just an agenda to complain,' Commissioner Eric Cooley said. 'We’re up here debating, without purpose.'

item.title: Ormond Beach DAR Chapter memorializes slice of history at Sanchez Park
item.description: The installation of a new historical marker last fall is part of a national effort to recognize patriots as the U.S. approaches its 250th anniversary.

item.title: Young landscaping business owner files to run for Ormond Beach mayor
item.description: Damien Curry, owner of Garden Boys Landscaping, filed to run for the open seat on Feb. 13.

item.title: Plantation Bay pool home is Ormond Beach's top sale at $695K
item.description: Built in 2017, the house is a 3/2 and has a pool and 2,608 square feet.

item.title: Latitude Margaritaville home is West Daytona Beach's top sale at $610K
item.description: Built in 2019, the house is a 2/2 and has 1,922 square feet.

item.title: Tased and arrested: Ormond Beach man pulls knife on deputies during domestic incident
item.description: Deputies say the suspect brandished a knife during a domestic disturbance, prompting the use of a Taser before he was taken into custody.

item.title: Washington man calls 911 to try to avoid ticket for expired tag
Flagler County Sheriff’s Office, gaming commission serve four warrants in illegal gambling probe
item.description: Detectives seized 20 illegal gaming machines and more than $16,800 in cash during raids at four Flagler County businesses.

item.title: Decades in the making, Ormond Beach Founder's Day to be held April 25
item.description: The city celebrated the construction of a road extension around the Sports Complex last year, paving the way for what Doug Thomas hopes will be a new community tradition: Ormond Beach Founder's Day.
